scope: Experimental installer/tuner validation, including real-model 96K runs; not a speedup claim over manual presets
realCompileOnlyToolchainProbe: passed with GCC 15.3.1, CUDA 13.3 and SM86
httpAndSubprocessLifecycle: covered by real CPU-only fake-server integration tests

realModel.hardware: RTX 3060 12 GB, Core i5-12400, 16 GB RAM, Linux
realModel.realSafetyRejection: More GPU-resident placement rejected at 686 MiB free against 768 MiB margin
realModel.diagnosticRegression: Fixed and tested propagation of the guard reason through a closed HTTP request

limitations: Fake-server integration tests validate orchestration, not LLM output quality or GPU memory prediction
Real tuning reused the pinned model and existing standalone build; the entire guided fresh download/build flow was not rerun end to end
The normal model router was paused with user approval; harness services and their configurations were not changed
Earlier published throughput results are not automatic-tuner results
Memory sampling and short fixtures do not certify every peak or near-full-context workload
